exposure: Intrathecal isobaric bupivacaine dose (5 mg vs 7 mg) combined with 15 mcg fentanyl
cohort: 80 patients (ASA physical status I and II, aged 16-50 years) undergoing elective caesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
finding: A 5 mg dose of intrathecal isobaric bupivacaine combined with 15 mcg fentanyl provided adequate anesthesia for caesarean section while maintaining better hemodynamic stability compared to a 7 mg dose.
